name: SupermarketShoppingNoVaImpulseBuying

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating a realistic no-VA supermarket conversation. Sigma does not appear. One person keeps adding things to the cart that weren't on the list — the other keeps quietly editing it. This happens repeatedly.

Write dialogue that sounds like real people with different shopping styles in the same cart. Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters. No exceptions.
- Sigma does not appear at any point
- Hugo adds things because they're interesting; Nadia questions because she's practical today
- The pattern repeats 3-4 times with variation
- It's funny rather than frustrating — they enjoy this dynamic

sound_effects_config.prompt: Supermarket ambience, background store music, products being placed in cart, aisle browsing sounds

initial_prompt:
Generate a no-VA conversation where Hugo keeps adding things to the cart that weren't on the list — something discounted, something interesting, something he spotted. Nadia is more budget-conscious today and keeps questioning or quietly returning things. This pattern happens at least three times. Hugo makes his case each time with genuine enthusiasm. Sometimes he wins, sometimes he doesn't. The whole thing is warm and slightly funny — this is just how they shop.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Sigma must not appear at any point
- Hugo's additions are always genuinely interesting, not frivolous
- Nadia's objections are always legitimate
- The pattern repeats but with variation — different items, different outcomes

user2.name: Nadia
user2.tts_prompt: Intellectually engaged, mild European accent, practically firm today

setting.relationship_dynamic: He finds things, she edits the cart — an established system

scenario_template.note: Outcome: could go either way. He wins this one or she returns it. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.note: He's already building a case in his head before she reacts. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.note: Opposite outcome to the first negotiation. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Hugo finds something that actually turns the tables — Nadia wants it too
scenario_template.note: He found something she genuinely wants. He takes a quiet victory. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Heading to checkout — brief accounting of the additions
scenario_template.note: The cart has more than planned. They're fine with it. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: Hugo
user1.role: Shopper who finds things. Genuinely interested in what he picks up. Makes considered but enthusiastic cases. Delighted when he wins.

user2.name: Nadia
user2.role: Practical today. Not opposed to additions but needs to be convinced. Evaluates quickly and fairly. Has her own weakness for certain things.

conversation_structure: Sigma must not appear or be mentioned.
The impulse-buying pattern repeats at least 3 times with different outcomes.
Hugo's additions must be genuinely interesting — not random junk.
Nadia's objections must be legitimate — not arbitrary.
The third addition creates a reversal — she wants it too.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
